cards.front: Which SGA is associated with the highest metabolic risk and an NNH of 3 for weight gain $\ge 7\%$ in pediatric patients?
cards.back: Olanzapine (Dulcan p.823, StahlKids p.351)

cards.front: In the "Three Bears" model of Quetiapine dosing, what clinical effect is achieved at the "Baby Bear" dose (25-100 mg)?
cards.back: Sedative/Hypnotic effect via $H_{1}$ antagonism (StahlNeuro p.219, StahlKids p.419)

cards.front: What pharmacological action defines the "Mama Bear" dose (300 mg) of Quetiapine for treating bipolar depression?
cards.back: NET inhibition and $5\text{-HT}_{2C}$ antagonism via the active metabolite Norquetiapine (StahlNeuro p.218-219, StahlKids p.409)

cards.front: What is the primary pharmacological requirement to reach the "Papa Bear" level (400-800 mg) of Quetiapine?
cards.back: Achieving $D_{2}$ receptor occupancy above $60\%$ for antipsychotic/antimanic efficacy (StahlNeuro p.219, StahlKids p.412)

cards.front: According to pediatric clinical trials, what is the efficacy ceiling for Risperidone in treating Schizophrenia or Bipolar Disorder?
cards.back: 3 mg/day, as higher doses increase side effects without additional benefit (StahlKids p.425, p.428)

cards.front: Which two SGAs are associated with the most severe treatment-emergent elevations in Prolactin levels?
cards.back: Risperidone and Paliperidone (Dulcan p.825, StahlKids p.367, p.423)

cards.front: What unique pharmacokinetic property distinguishes Paliperidone from Risperidone regarding its elimination?
cards.back: Paliperidone is primarily renally excreted with $< 10\%$ hepatic metabolism (Dulcan p.786, StahlKids p.367)

cards.front: Which specific pharmacological combination is FDA-approved for treating pediatric bipolar depression in patients aged 10 and older?
cards.back: Olanzapine and Fluoxetine (Symbyax) (Dulcan p.301, StahlKids p.351)

cards.front: In the IMPACT study, what intervention was found to be as effective as switching to a lower-risk SGA for managing antipsychotic-induced weight gain?
cards.back: Adding Metformin (500-1000 mg bid) (Dulcan p.824, p.835)

cards.front: What serum Prolactin threshold in a symptomatic child requires an MRI of the sella turcica to rule out prolactinoma?
Which SGA had a $48\%$ incidence of ALT elevation compared to $3\%$ in the placebo group during pediatric controlled trials?
cards.back: Olanzapine (Dulcan p.825-826, StahlKids p.352)

cards.front: What HOMA-IR value serves as a threshold indicating significant insulin resistance in adolescents?
Why is the use of Quetiapine generally discouraged for treating pediatric bipolar depression despite its use in adults?
cards.back: It failed to demonstrate efficacy over placebo in pediatric RCTs (Dulcan p.301, p.805, StahlKids p.418)

cards.front: What critical clinical warning is associated with the administration of Paliperidone OROS tablets?
cards.back: They must be swallowed whole and never crushed, chewed, or halved (StahlKids p.377)

cards.front: What life-threatening skin condition is specifically warned against in the prescribing information for Olanzapine?
cards.back: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) (StahlKids p.352, p.354)

cards.front: How does cigarette smoking typically affect the plasma levels of Olanzapine?
cards.back: It induces CYP1A2, which significantly decreases Olanzapine levels (Dulcan p.786, StahlKids p.356)

cards.front: Which pharmacological mechanism allows Aripiprazole to effectively lower Prolactin levels when added to other SGAs?
cards.back: Partial $D_{2}$ agonism (StahlNeuro p.188, Dulcan p.835-836)

cards.front: What is the recommended frequency for monitoring BMI in children and adolescents after initiating Olanzapine?
cards.back: Monthly for the first 3 months, then quarterly (StahlKids p.351)

cards.front: What serum ratio is used as a marker for insulin resistance in adolescents besides the HOMA-IR?
cards.back: Triglycerides/HDL ratio $> 3.5$ (Dulcan p.829-830)

cards.front: What is the minimal age approved by the FDA for using Risperidone to treat irritability associated with Autism Spectrum Disorder?
cards.back: 5 years old (Dulcan p.787, StahlKids p.423)
